definition.cross15: 0.50 crossing of the YES mid at the last candle ending <= T-1h, spread <= 0.15 (the baseline = implied_total)
definition.main_strike: the strike (a number like 233.5) whose mid is closest to 0.50, spread <= 0.10, tie -> lower strike
definition.vw_cross: 0.50 crossing of the candle-volume-weighted mid over the hour before T-1h (zero-volume hour: last mid); strikes as in cross15
